t: A lesson on how AI sees images as pixel patterns, on paper or in a spreadsheet.
steps: Find the AI and image recognition lesson on the Digital Technologies Hub.
Download the Excel files for the spreadsheet path.
Prepare the explainer videos and the pixel viewer link.
Draw 10 cm grids for the paper path.
Run the learning hook on how a computer tells objects apart.
Run the partner activity with the 5 x 7 grid.
